bundle.shortDescription: Clean disks and package caches, and uninstall programs completely
bundle.longDescription: WattClean frees disk space and removes traces of what you do: browser caches, cookies and history, temporary files, thumbnails, logs and the caches of dozens of applications, and the caches of APT, DNF, Zypper, pacman, Flatpak, Snap, Nix and Homebrew through their own commands. It lists what every package manager installed and removes it together with the settings and caches it leaves in your home folder, to the Trash. Shred files and wipe free space.
